title: Offer an expanded view showing contents when widget is large
line: A new Trash Folder widget lists the files in the trash on the desktop or in a panel, with Empty Trash and Restore in its menu.
explanation: The Trash widget is only an icon with a label, however large it is made, and the only way to see the trash contents on the desktop was a hand-configured Folder View pointing at trash:/. Folder View already handles trash:/ well (Empty Trash, Restore to Former Location), but nothing offered it as a ready-made widget. The change adds a Folder View preset, org.kde.plasma.trashfolder ("Trash Folder"), served from the same package like Kicker and Dashboard: it always shows trash:/, hides the Location settings page, shows a trash icon in panels and is offered as an alternative to the Trashcan widget. Applet settings now open on the first visible page, so the hidden Location page isn't shown on its own.

commits.message:
containments/folder: add a Trash Folder widget showing the trash

The Trash widget only shows an icon, even when made big on the desktop.
Add a Folder View preset that always lists trash:/, like Kicker and
Dashboard, and make applet settings open on their first visible page.

BUG: 360388

media.caption: Master: the Trash widget made large on the desktop still shows only an icon and an item count.
Fix: the new Trash Folder widget on the desktop lists the trashed files.
Master: searching "trash" in the widget explorer finds only Trashcan.
Fix: the widget explorer also offers Trash Folder.
Fix: right-clicking empty space in Trash Folder offers Empty Trash (files offer Restore to Former Location).
Fix: in a panel it shows a trash icon and lists the trash in its popup.
